name: page
label: Data Items Paginated
description: Column definition and row definitions for a particular page is passed to this component

name: count
label: Count of total records
description: This number represents the total count of rows for the data table(not per page)

name: pageSizeOptions
label: Number of supported page sizes for data table
description: Array of data table page sizes to be supported

name: availableColumns
label: Array of columns definitions for all supported columns
description: Array of columns definitions for all supported columns

name: defaultPageSize
label: Page Size of the first page loaded by default
description: Default page size for first page loaded by the data table

name: options
label: Extra options to be passed directly to now-list

name: loaders
label: Loaders for page and count
description: Loaders for page and count, useful if you are calling an api to get the data
